reading.zh: 从左到右：扫描节点与补件超时（scan 下分节点、补件两路）→ 站内信 + 邮件双通道下发催办（dispatch）→ 必要时抄送上级（escalate）；全程只催办，不自动跳过、不自动升级。
reading.en: Left to right: scan for overdue tasks and supplements (scan, split into node and supplement), dispatch the reminder over both channels (dispatch), and optionally CC the superior (escalate) — always a reminder only, never an automatic skip or escalation.
